# Logging

**Library** · TypeScript

Structured logs, written the same way in every part of the shop.

Shared by the web app and the Checkout API. Each is built with its own copy, so it's drawn inside each one's component view.

## Contains

- [JsonLogger](json-logger.md) (class) – Writes one JSON line per message.
